_doc: Allowlisted one-way export of the personal study engine (workspace tools/) into engine/studycore/vendor/. Versioned: bump `version` when a vendored file's contract changes; sync_engine.py refuses to run when a vendored copy was edited by hand (drift) and lists what differs. Excluded on purpose: moodle.py (school-specific SSO session), homework.py, outlook.py, agent_runner.py, guard.py, notify.py (act in the owner's name or e-mail him), secrets, study content, courses.
